_comment: Copy this file to cypress.env.json and fill in real values. cypress.env.json is gitignored and must never be committed. Every value can also be supplied as an environment variable instead, prefixed with CYPRESS_ (e.g. CYPRESS_VALID_PIN=12345), which is the preferred way to pass them in CI.
VALID_PIN: <5-digit PIN for the QA teacher account>
INVALID_PIN: <any 5-digit PIN that is NOT valid, used by negative tests>
SCHOOL_NAME: <school name as shown in the Sign In school dropdown>
SCHOOL_SEARCH_TERM: <a substring of the school name, used to search the dropdown>
